name.ja: 1/1 シャアザクくんDXセット(ランナーVer.再現パーツ付き)
name.en: 1/1 Char's Zaku-kun DX set (Runner Ver. with reproduction parts)

description.ja: ガンプラの楽しさを伝える『ガンプラくん』から「シャアザクくん」が登場！
description.en: "Char's Zaku-kun " appears from " Gunpla-kun" which conveys the fun of Gunpla!

description.ja: 選択式でランナーVer.でもディスプレイが可能！おなじみの装備も付属。
description.en: You can also display it in RunnerVer. by selecting it! Familiar equipment is also included.

description.ja: • シャアザクくんの通常Ver.とランナーVer.を選択式でディスプレイ。
description.en: • Char's Zaku-kun's normal version and Runner version are displayed in a selection format.

description.ja: • お馴染みの装備「ヒート・ホーク」「ザク・マシンガン」「ザク・バズーカ」も付属。
description.en: • Familiar equipment "Heat Hawk ", " Zaku Machine Gun ", and " Zaku Bazooka" are also included.

description.ja: • モノアイは左右に可動。
description.en: • Monoeye can move left and right.

description.ja: • 別売りの「ガンプラくん」シリーズプラモデルを揃えて劇中をイメージしたディスプレイをしよう！
description.en: • Create a display inspired by the movie by arranging the "Gunpla-kun" series plastic models (sold separately)!
